name: triad
description: Multi-agent CLI/TUI built with Go and Bubbletea

scripts.build:binaries: cmd /c "set GOOS=windows&& set GOARCH=amd64&& go build -o dist/triad-win-x64.exe main.go&& set GOOS=darwin&& set GOARCH=arm64&& go build -o dist/triad-darwin-arm64 main.go&& set GOOS=darwin&& set GOARCH=amd64&& go build -o dist/triad-darwin-x64 main.go&& set GOOS=linux&& set GOARCH=amd64&& go build -o dist/triad-linux-x64 main.go"
